name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a file from the filesystem. Supports text and binary files. Can read specific line ranges or entire file.

name: write_file
description: Write content to a file, creating it if it doesn't exist or overwriting if it does. Creates parent directories as needed.

name: list_directory
description: List all files and directories in a given path. Supports recursive listing and filtering by pattern.

name: search_files
description: Search for files matching a pattern using glob syntax. Supports wildcards and recursive search across directory trees.

name: git_status
description: Get the current git repository status, including modified files, staged changes, and branch information.

name: git_commit
description: Create a new git commit with the staged changes and a commit message.

name: git_diff
description: Show differences between commits, branches, or working directory. Displays line-by-line changes.

name: git_log
description: Display commit history with messages, authors, and timestamps. Supports filtering and formatting options.

name: run_shell_command
description: Execute a shell command and return its output. Supports environment variables and working directory specification.

name: http_get
description: Make an HTTP GET request to a URL and return the response body. Supports custom headers and query parameters.

name: http_post
description: Make an HTTP POST request with JSON or form data. Returns response status and body.

name: parse_json
description: Parse a JSON string into a structured object. Validates syntax and returns parsed data or error details.

name: format_json
description: Format and pretty-print JSON data with configurable indentation and sorting.

name: parse_yaml
description: Parse YAML formatted text into structured data. Handles multi-document YAML and complex nested structures.

name: format_yaml
description: Convert structured data to YAML format with proper indentation and formatting conventions.

name: calculate_hash
description: Calculate cryptographic hash (MD5, SHA256, SHA512) of text or file content.

name: encode_base64
description: Encode text or binary data to base64 format for safe transmission or storage.

name: decode_base64
description: Decode base64 encoded data back to its original form.

name: get_current_time
description: Get the current date and time in various formats (ISO, Unix timestamp, custom format).

name: parse_date
description: Parse date strings in various formats and convert to ISO format or timestamp.

name: format_date
description: Format a date/timestamp according to a specified format string.

name: calculate_date_diff
description: Calculate the difference between two dates in various units (days, hours, minutes).

name: generate_uuid
description: Generate a random UUID (v4) for unique identifiers.

name: validate_email
description: Validate email address format using RFC-compliant regex patterns.

name: validate_url
description: Validate URL format and optionally check if the resource is accessible.

name: extract_urls
description: Extract all URLs from a text string using pattern matching.

name: extract_emails
description: Extract all email addresses from a text string.

name: count_words
description: Count words, characters, lines, and sentences in a text string.

name: find_and_replace
description: Find and replace text using literal strings or regular expressions.

name: split_text
description: Split text into chunks by delimiter, line breaks, or fixed size.

name: join_text
description: Join an array of strings with a specified delimiter.

name: convert_case
description: Convert text case: uppercase, lowercase, title case, camel case, snake case.

name: generate_random_string
description: Generate a random string with specified length and character set.

name: compress_text
description: Compress text using gzip or other compression algorithms.

name: decompress_text
description: Decompress previously compressed text data.

name: calculate_checksum
description: Calculate CRC32 or other checksum for data integrity verification.

name: convert_units
description: Convert between different units of measurement (length, weight, temperature, etc).

name: calculate_percentage
description: Calculate percentage, percentage change, or percentage of a value.

name: round_number
description: Round numbers to specified decimal places or significant figures.

name: format_number
description: Format numbers with thousands separators, currency symbols, or custom patterns.

name: parse_csv
description: Parse CSV formatted text into structured array of objects.

name: format_csv
description: Convert structured data to CSV format with proper escaping.

name: sort_array
description: Sort an array of values in ascending or descending order.

name: filter_array
description: Filter array elements based on a condition or pattern.

name: unique_array
description: Remove duplicate values from an array.

name: merge_objects
description: Deep merge multiple objects into a single object.

name: query_database
description: Execute SQL queries against SQLite database and return results.

name: create_table
description: Create a new database table with specified schema.

name: insert_record
description: Insert a new record into a database table.

name: update_record
description: Update existing database records matching a condition.
